name: Pristine Surgical
old_description: “The Summit arthroscope performed exceptionally well, and the procedure went according to plan,” said Dr. Mark Getelman, who specializes in arthroscopic and minimally invasive reconstructive surgery of the shoulder and knee at SCOI and is past president of the Arthroscopy Association of North America (AANA). “The ability to get a new 4K scope for every procedure while improving our workflow makes Summit an exciting product for our operating room. We’re proud to have performed this procedure at SCOI where surgical innovation has been a hallmark of our practice since our founding.”
about:
Pristine Surgical operates from Manchester, New Hampshire, as a medical device company founded to simplify endoscopy. The company combines single-use endoscopes with cloud-based software to make minimally invasive visualization more efficient, consistent, and safe. While the founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, the board includes representatives from Piney Lake Capital Management and former Medtronic executives.

The company's flagship product, Summit™, is a first-of-its-kind 4K single-use surgical arthroscope delivered through a "Scopes as a Subscription™" model with transparent pricing and automated inventory management. All systems come pre-installed with Pristine Connect®, a cloud-based platform that handles inventory, image and video sharing, and digital training checklists. Pristine Surgical is developing a full portfolio of rigid and flexible endoscopes spanning arthroscopy, laparoscopy, and flexible endoscopy, addressing a market of approximately 125 million procedures worldwide each year.

The company serves hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, and orthopedic surgeons specializing in sports medicine. Clinical users include Southern California Orthopedic Institute, UCLA, Hospital for Special Surgery in New York, Virtua Health in New Jersey, Doral Surgery Center in Florida, and Stetson Lee Orthopaedics in California. The medical advisory board features prominent orthopedic surgeons such as Mark Getelman, MD, David McAllister, MD, Stephen Snyder, MD, and Riley Williams III, MD.

Pristine Surgical was started to remove inefficiency, variability, and safety issues from the endoscopy suite. Conventional reusable systems require costly maintenance contracts, sterilization services, and repairs, while dirty or damaged scopes disrupt workflow and present safety risks. The single-use platform eliminates cleaning and maintenance, reduces operating room setup and teardown time, and provides a new high-definition image for every procedure.
